proof_attempt_summary: Seven D0 solve rounds established binary/full-record reduction, a uniform hashing transfer and terminating rational evaluator, certified calibration brackets, endpoint obstructions, product-prior bounds and the cited diagonal converse with liminf kC_k >= 1. Mathematical review passes after primary source attestations, but the all-k matching saddle, binding count/overlap states, optimal supports and endpoint transitions remain explicitly open. Independent terminal-validity consultation confirms a sound incremental partial result below the field floor, with no bounded faithful repair; retry only after solving the structural kernel, and no formalization was entered.
tldr: For two bounded potential-outcome rosters fixed before randomization, the causal target is the difference between their marginal top-\(k\) means. Common-threshold integration, joint label symmetrization and uniform bin-maximum transfer establish the all-design risk reduction and fixed-rank limit \(C_k=V_k\). A terminating evaluator certifies this value to any rational tolerance and supplies procedures on the entire original record. The Sharp SATE result transfers exactly on the diagonal and then through padding: \(R_{nk}\ge R_{kk}=\rho_k^\star\), hence \(C_k\ge\rho_k^\star\) and \(\liminf_{k\to\infty}kC_k\ge1\). The explicit even- and odd-rank product-prior floors remain finite-rank certificates; their \(237/500\) asymptotic corollary is superseded by this cited converse. No matching all-rank upper rate is proved. The global brackets remain \(C_2\in[0.237,0.240]\), \(C_4\in[0.1185,0.231305]\), \(C_8\in[0.05925,0.140875]\), and \(C_{16}\in[0.029625,0.086866)\). The established obstruction excludes endpoint-only optimizers at these four ranks and bounds rank-sixteen optimal endpoint mass strictly below \(0.347464\). The structural saddle, least-favorable overlaps, optimal fraction supports, endpoint-mass attainment and transition ranks remain unresolved.
gap: Sharp SATE and Hull solve joint design and decoding for a mean contrast. COVES motivates upper-tail comparisons but uses sampled regression and a fixed tail fraction. Neither result evaluates the nonlinear marginal tail endpoint when a fixed number of severe outcomes determines each arm mean.
fill: The paired-count profile evaluates this precision tradeoff over the entire bounded-table class, with global risk certificates, optimizer-support classification and an attaining finite-cohort procedure.
